features.text: UNIVERSAL FIT DESIGN: Adjustable lacing system accommodates both small and large wrist sizes.
SPEED-LACER SYSTEM: Enables one-handed tightening for easy, secure application.
MALLEABLE STAYS: Provide customizable stabilization and improved wrist positioning.
BREATHABLE, SOFT MATERIALS: Offer long-lasting comfort for day or night wear.
TWO LENGTH OPTIONS: Choose 8" for light support or 10" for added forearm stabilization.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
